response.technical_approach:
TECHNICAL APPROACH

Our technical approach addresses the challenge many agencies face with fingerprint collection quality.

Challenge: NSWC IHD needs seamless fingerprint services across multiple locations.

Approach: We implemented a three-phase delivery model through certified subcontractors.

Result:

98.3% first-pass acceptance rate on a $847K similar contract.

Our methodology includes:

1.

Subcontractor vetting and SWFT certification verification. 2.

Live Scan equipment deployment at 127 nationwide locations. 3.

Web-based scheduling system integration as prescribed in requirements. 4.

Quality control monitoring with real-time rejection tracking.

Figure 1 illustrates our network coverage model.

Each location maintains current DCSA certification in accordance with federal standards.

We monitor performance weekly through automated reporting systems.

Electronic Fingerprint Transmissions process within 24 hours of collection.

Challenge: Previous contracts experienced 4.2% rejection rates industry-wide.

Our solution reduced rejection rates to 1.7% average.

We achieved this through enhanced quality control protocols.

Subcontractors receive monthly performance scorecards with measurable benchmarks.

Compliance with OPM standards drives our approach.

We handle fingerprint data pursuant to federal privacy laws.

Each transmission meets SWFT requirements exactly.

Performance metrics track against the 40 monthly scan average.

In summary:

- Active SWFT certified network across all 50 states. 
- Live Scan equipment at convenient contractor locations. 
- Web-based scheduling system with government access. 
- Quality control maintaining sub-2% rejection rates.
response.understanding_of_requirement:
UNDERSTANDING OF REQUIREMENT

NSWC IHD requires Secured Web Fingerprint Transmission services for personnel background investigations pursuant to solicitation N0017426Q1009.

The contractor must provide electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment.

Services include web-based scheduling systems and FD-258 card processing.

Electronic Fingerprint Transmissions support federal investigations with 900 personnel capacity annually.

Key requirements include active SWFT certification through DCSA.

Compliance with OPM standards is mandatory.

The contractor must maintain nationwide geographic coverage at convenient locations.

Rejection rates must stay below 2% for electronic fingerprint submissions.

We share NSWC IHD's commitment to security and precision in this critical mission.
